nom: DERMA E Vitamin C Concentrated Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report brightening and reduced hyperpigmentation without breakouts, though one with normal-to-oily skin saw only drying and slight redness with no improvement in tone or firmness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally describe the serum as hydrating and non-greasy, sometimes enough to skip a separate moisturizer, though one with dry, sensitive skin noticed skin turning drier and less glowy once she delayed repurchasing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one describing an oily T-zone with normal/balanced rest of face, report good results with brightening and no breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several (including a self-described esthetician) say it has never irritated their skin and even helped with brightening, while others report bumps, redness, a rosacea-type rash, or burning after just days of use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 70s report brighter, firmer, or younger-looking skin, though one 69-year-old found the texture too watery and only mildly effective on uneven tone.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report firmer, younger-looking, brighter skin; one long-term user felt the formula changed over time and became less effective for firmness or tone concerns.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as hydrating, moisturizing, and non-drying even for dry skin; a minority report their skin became drier when they stopped or delayed repurchasing, and one found it too watery in consistency.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or general redness say it evened tone and reduced redness, but others with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin report the opposite — burning, a bright red face, or a rosacea-type rash after only days of use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically credits the serum with strengthening her skin barrier and improving how well makeup wore over it; no other barrier-specific complaints are reported.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers, especially those with acne scarring or hyperpigmentation, report visible fading of dark spots within weeks to a month; a couple say it did nothing for hyperpigmentation even after extended use, including one who saw no change on brown skin over two years.
concerns.blemishes: Numerous reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal/stress acne report clearer skin, smaller-looking pores, and fewer new blemishes within weeks; conversely, several reviewers describe new breakouts, cystic-type bumps, or backne shortly after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the serum is not oily or greasy despite hydrating well, and another mentions a slightly greasy feel immediately after application that resolves once absorbed; no reports of increased long-term oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Formula or packaging changed over time

extraits.texte: Decided to try because the other vitamin C serums I've tried are too expensive. After 2 days of use, my face broke out in a rosacea type rash. Especially my entire chin. I do have sensitive skin, but never had this happen from a serum before. I'm in a w/c now, but will be returning as soon as I can walk again.

Been using this product and it does NOT work! Second year and I am still waiting for a change. Definitely does not work on brown skin. Doesn't lighten dark spots and does absolutely nothing for hyperpigmentation. The ONLY plus is that it's mild on sensitive skin. And that is why i used it for two years!

I bought this originally to protect my face against the intense pollution during the Canada fires, and it changed my skin. My face was dull before and lacking vibrancy, this made my face very vibrant and bright! It helped me with some acne scarring and got rid of my redness, I had some mild rosacea. It has aloe in it so it was soothing when I got some sunburns too. A little goes a LONG way with this product, so I cut the usage a lot from what it said on the package (I'm assuming it said use one pump day and night to make it run out faster so people would buy more), I used half a pump in the mornings only (because I don't need much protection when I'm asleep?) and I have about 1/4 of the bottle left and ive been using for 6 months. Although, some of the ingredients are questionable and I'm not sure everything is listed correctly since some were complaining of allergic reactions, even though it was completely fine on my skin. I don't know if the potency was reduced since I have had it for a while, or if my skin got used to it, but after a while it didn't work as much and I switched to something else. But this was overall great, its super hydrating and sticky when it dried so always put on before moisturizer. I just wish it was a tad bit cheaper since I have found other ones that work just as weak for at least $5 less.

extraits.titre: This is a must have in my skin care routine
extraits.texte: This Vitamin C Serum has been a game changer for me! With rosacea you never know what can trigger your skin to react causing uneven tones. This not only helped to even out the uneven areas of my skin, it also hydrates it without making it feel too heavy which is a big deal living in Florida.

Been using this for over a year at least and didn't really notice that it made a huge difference over time. I have dry, sensitive skin so I have kept repurchasing but after running out and not rebuying soon enough (especially in winter weather), I noticed my skin is drier, not as smooth, and definitely not as glowy! It also has great ingredients and vitamin C that is friendly to sensitive skin like mine

I am blown away by this product. Natural ingredients, cruelty free, but crazy effective. My skin LOVES this. I have dry skin with discoloration, dark/hollow under eyes, redness, hormonal acne, sensitive skin. This product aborbs very quickly and makes my skin look and feel fresh. It definitely does a great job at brightening and the added hyaluronic acid gives a nice moisture boost. It is NOT sticky as some have claimed. You are likely using too much product. The ease of the pump allows you to control the amount of product. 1 pump is plenty to cover the face. The price point for the natural ingredients + the effectiveness of the product makes this a 10/10 for me!

Has worked well for me in the past and continues to do so. I have Ecuadorean heritage; combination skin, oily T-zone and normal/balanced rest of face. Wet my face with water or toner, then apply the serum as well as the vitamin C night cream from same brand.
